generator_cmd:
bash gen.sh OUT (Info-ZIP zip with TZ=UTC + one `TZ=Asia/Tokyo zip -g` entry for a DOS-local skew; touch -d mtimes incl. 2037 future; jq-built delivery manifest with derived_from/parent_id/source claims: chain alpha-01->02->03, orphan bravo-02->bravo-01, cycle charlie-01<->02; Pillow JPEGs + exiftool -XMP-xmpMM:DocumentID/DerivedFromDocumentID, python zipfile writer; Pillow PNG renamed .zip decoy): #!/bin/bash
# gen.sh <outdir>: Info-ZIP (UT extras; TZ=Asia/Tokyo for a DOS-local skew), touch -d mtimes, jq manifest with
# derived_from/parent_id/source claims (chain, orphan, cycle); Pillow JPEGs + exiftool XMP DerivedFrom; python zipfile.
set -e
O=$1; W=$(mktemp -d); cd $W
mkdir -p c/artifacts; cd c/artifacts
printf 'root note\n' > alpha-01.txt; printf 'edit one\n' > alpha-02.txt; printf 'edit two\n' > alpha-03.txt
printf 'Write-Output 1\n' > bravo-02.ps1; printf '{"a":1}\n' > charlie-01.json; printf '{"b":2}\n' > charlie-02.json
printf 'skewed\n' > delta-01.txt; printf 'future\n' > echo-01.txt
touch -d '2026-01-01 00:00:00Z' alpha-01.txt; touch -d '2026-02-01 10:00:00Z' alpha-02.txt
touch -d '2026-03-14 08:52:38Z' alpha-03.txt bravo-02.ps1; touch -d '2026-04-01 12:00:00Z' charlie-01.json charlie-02.json
touch -d '2026-05-05 05:05:04Z' delta-01.txt; touch -d '2037-06-01 00:00:00Z' echo-01.txt
cd ..
jq -n -c '{schema:"huntress.artifact_delivery_manifest.v1",artifacts:[
 {id:"alpha-01",filename:"alpha-01.txt",path:"artifacts/alpha-01.txt"},
 {id:"alpha-02",filename:"alpha-02.txt",path:"artifacts/alpha-02.txt",derived_from:"alpha-01"},
 {id:"alpha-03",filename:"alpha-03.txt",path:"artifacts/alpha-03.txt",parent_id:"artifacts/alpha-02.txt"},
 {id:"bravo-02",filename:"bravo-02.ps1",path:"artifacts/bravo-02.ps1",derived_from:"bravo-01"},
 {id:"charlie-01",filename:"charlie-01.json",path:"artifacts/charlie-01.json",derived_from:"charlie-02"},
 {id:"charlie-02",filename:"charlie-02.json",path:"artifacts/charlie-02.json",source:"charlie-01"},
 {id:"delta-01",filename:"delta-01.txt",path:"artifacts/delta-01.txt"},
 {id:"echo-01",filename:"echo-01.txt",path:"artifacts/echo-01.txt"}]}' > delivery-manifest.json
touch -d '2026-06-01 00:00:00Z' delivery-manifest.json
TZ=UTC zip -q ../tl_c201.zip delivery-manifest.json artifacts/alpha-0*.txt artifacts/bravo-02.ps1 artifacts/charlie-0*.json artifacts/echo-01.txt
TZ=Asia/Tokyo zip -q -g ../tl_c201.zip artifacts/delta-01.txt
cd ..
python3 -c 'from PIL import Image
for n,c in (("img-a",(10,20,30)),("img-b",(40,50,60)),("img-c",(70,80,90)),("img-d",(1,2,3))): Image.new("RGB",(8,8),c).save(n+".jpg")'
exiftool -q -overwrite_original -XMP-xmpMM:DocumentID=xmp.did:AAA1 -XMP-xmpMM:InstanceID=xmp.iid:AAA1 img-a.jpg
exiftool -q -overwrite_original -XMP-xmpMM:DocumentID=xmp.did:BBB2 -XMP-xmpMM:InstanceID=xmp.iid:BBB2 -XMP-xmpMM:DerivedFromDocumentID=xmp.did:AAA1 -XMP-xmpMM:DerivedFromInstanceID=xmp.iid:AAA1 img-b.jpg
exiftool -q -overwrite_original -XMP-xmpMM:DocumentID=xmp.did:CCC3 -XMP-xmpMM:DerivedFromDocumentID=xmp.did:BBB2 img-c.jpg
exiftool -q -overwrite_original -XMP-xmpMM:DocumentID=xmp.did:DDD4 -XMP-xmpMM:DerivedFromDocumentID=xmp.did:ZZZ9 img-d.jpg
python3 -c 'import zipfile
z=zipfile.ZipFile("tl_xmp.zip","w")
for i,n in enumerate(("img-a","img-b","img-c","img-d")):
    zi=zipfile.ZipInfo(n+".jpg",(2026,7,1+i,9,0,0)); z.writestr(zi,open(n+".jpg","rb").read())
z.close()'
python3 -c 'from PIL import Image; Image.new("RGB",(4,4)).save("decoy.png")'; cp decoy.png tl_decoy_png.zip
mkdir n; printf a > n/x1.txt; printf b > n/x2.txt; touch -d '2026-03-14 08:52:38Z' n/*; (cd n && TZ=UTC zip -q ../tl_noclaims.zip x1.txt x2.txt)
cp tl_c201.zip tl_xmp.zip tl_decoy_png.zip tl_noclaims.zip $O/
oracle_cmd: zipinfo -v ZIP | grep -E 'DOS date|UT extra field modtime.*UTC' (DOS read as naive UTC; mismatch = DOS != UT UTC; future = after 2026-10-31; earliest/latest/groups by UT UTC) ; unzip -p ZIP delivery-manifest.json | jq -r '.artifacts[]|[.id,(.derived_from//.parent_id//.source//"-")]|@tsv' (edges walked by hand: present parent -> chain, absent parent -> orphan, mutual -> cycle)
